why: Replacing the examples with negation/Unless/except/measurement cases taught the model to avoid cutting around scope-bearing tokens (negators, subordinators, exception markers and measurement phrases). That made it keep longer multiword constituents intact (small net gain on very long pieces, ≤99:+0.008) but pushed cuts into nearby short spans, producing small harms in the short-latency bins (≤3..≤10 negative) and slightly more (741) worsened than 690 improved pairs.
lesson: Respect scope-bearing attachments (negation, subordinators, exceptions, measurement phrases) but do so without shifting cuts so they split adjacent short constituents or verb phrases.
